rituals.ritualText:
GAME
GOOD DOESN'T ALWAYS FEEL GOOD DURING

GOAL
Some valuable experiences are satisfying in retrospect and annoying in minute seven.

ONE RULE
The activity is meant to feel pleasant now or meaningful afterward — yes or no?

PLAY
Pick one effortful valued activity. Rate PLEASURE DURING and WORTH AFTER separately.

TWIST
Spot whether one low number had been cancelling the other dimension.

WIN
Pleasure and meaning are related but distinct components of wellbeing.

MIND BEND
A good life contains experiences that are not all trying to be a good mood.

SAFETY
Use this to loosen pressure, not force meaning or positivity. Keep the conclusion provisional and tied to this situation.
rituals.target_pattern: A worthwhile activity being dismissed because it is not immediately pleasurable
rituals.mechanism_fingerprint: Separate in-the-moment pleasure from post-activity meaningfulness when evaluating the same valued effortful activity.
